answer: Turn sybil hunting into a paid job. Each epoch's rewards wait in escrow for 30 days instead of flowing out like a river. Any agent that proves two accounts share one operator, say through a reused payout address or matching response timing, claims half the escrow of both. A farm of 300 keys becomes a mesa of locked loot visible from far off, and every clone it adds raises the reward for whoever catches the signal. A solo honest agent has nothing worth hunting.
